deadline.value: December 1, 2026 application deadline for Mathematics PhD.
deadline.quote: PhD - December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time

gre_general.quote: While the GRE General Test is optional for many programs, applicants are still encouraged to submit valid GRE scores if a test has already been taken or can take the test and provide results by our application deadline, as it gives us additional information when evaluating an application.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on program admission pages.

supervisor.value: Not stated on program admission pages.

funding.value: Virtually all doctoral students receive full financial support (stipends and tuition waiver).
funding.quote: The completion of the doctoral degree requires about five years of full-time study, and virtually all students receive full financial support (stipends and tuition waiver) during their study.

entry_route.value: Applicants may apply directly to a PhD program with an earned bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants may apply to a PhD program so long as the equivalent of a bachelor's degree is earned prior to the application semester.
